jobs.title: Global Paint Program Manager
jobs.description:
About JLG, an Oshkosh company

JLG began in 1969, when our founder, John L. Grove set out to resolve growing safety concerns in the construction industry. Since then we have been committed to understanding the challenges and delivering innovative solutions to the access market. We partner with customers to provide quality equipment, training opportunities and trusted support within the access industry. We are a global company, and our products—including mobile elevating work platforms, telehandlers, utility vehicles and accessories—can be found all over the world.

As the Global Paint Program Manager at Oshkosh Corporation, you will serve as the enterprise lead for coating and paint systems across global manufacturing and aftermarket operations. You will drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of paint processes, standards, and supplier partnerships to ensure product quality, color consistency, regulatory compliance, and operational excellence. Working cross-functionally with engineering, operations, quality, supply chain, and external suppliers, you will support new product launches, facility expansions, paint system installations, and strategic initiatives that reduce risk and minimize the cost of poor quality across the organization.
YOUR IMPACT

- Serve as the enterprise subject matter expert for paint and coating systems across global manufacturing and aftermarket operations.
- Develop, implement, and maintain global coating standards, specifications, and best practices to ensure consistent product quality, appearance, and performance.
- Lead the planning, installation, commissioning, and optimization of paint systems, pretreatment systems, and related manufacturing processes across global facilities.
- Support new product launches, facility expansions, and strategic manufacturing initiatives by establishing coating requirements and process standards.
- Partner with manufacturing, engineering, quality, supply chain, and external suppliers to drive operational excellence and continuous improvement.
- Manage relationships with global paint and coating suppliers to ensure material quality, performance, availability, and cost effectiveness.
- Evaluate, approve, and implement specialty paint colors and coating solutions while maintaining enterprise-wide color consistency standards.
- Develop and maintain maintenance strategies, operating procedures, and best practices for coating equipment and systems.
- Lead root cause investigations and corrective actions for coating-related quality issues across manufacturing sites and the supply base.
- Ensure compliance with environmental, safety, and regulatory requirements related to paint and coating operations.
- Identify and mitigate risks that could impact product quality, production schedules, or customer satisfaction.
- Provide technical guidance and training to manufacturing teams and stakeholders on coating processes, equipment, and standards.
- Lead cross-functional projects and influence decision-making to improve quality, reduce the cost of poor quality, and support business objectives.
- Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement across global operations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor’s degree in a related field and eight (8) or more years of relevant experience (equivalent to fourteen (14) years total in education and experience); or an equivalent combination of education and experience that demonstrates the ability to perform the essential functions of the role .

STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS
- Experience with industrial paint and coating systems, including pretreatment, application processes, curing technologies, and coating performance requirements.
- Proven success leading cross-functional manufacturing, quality, engineering, and supplier initiatives in a matrixed environment.
- Experience supporting paint system installations, facility expansions, capital projects, or manufacturing process improvements.
- Knowledge of coating-related quality systems, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement methodologies.
- Experience managing relationships with paint, coating, equipment, and chemical suppliers.
- Understanding of environmental, health, and safety regulations related to paint and coating operations.
- Experience developing global standards, specifications, and best practices across multiple manufacturing locations.

jobs.description:
About Oshkosh AeroTech, an Oshkosh company

Oshkosh AeroTech is a leading provider of aviation ground support products, gate equipment and airport services to commercial airlines, airports, air-freight carriers, ground handling and military customers. Oshkosh AeroTech offers products that make a difference in people’s lives by supporting those in our communities who do some of the toughest work. They own many of the most trusted brands in the air transportation industry, including LEKTRO®, JetAire®, JetPower®, AmpTekÔ, Jetway®, and more.

The Finance Analyst will support Oshkosh AeroTech’s Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team, with a balanced focus on FP&A and pricing activities. This role will support financial reporting, forecasting, budgeting, pricing and margin analysis while partnering across the business to understand performance and provide meaningful financial insights. The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills, attention to detail and the curiosity to understand the business behind the numbers.

YOUR IMPACT
These duties are not meant to be all-inclusive and other duties may be assigned.
- Support financial planning and analysis activities, including monthly reporting, forecasting, annual budgeting and analysis of business performance.
- Support the GSE pricing function through financial and margin analysis for customer bids and other pricing decisions.
- Assist with the annual refresh and ongoing maintenance of product price lists, steel surcharge calculations and customer pricing or frame agreements.
- Prepare and analyze financial and operational reporting for Oshkosh AeroTech, including information consolidated across GSE and Jetway and reported through the Vocational segment and Corporate.
- Track and report capital expenditures by project and site, providing visibility to spending and investment activity.
- Analyze and report backlog performance, including dollars, units and other key business metrics.
- Track weekly shipments and other operational indicators to support forecasting and business planning.
- Support month-end reporting and close activities for assigned areas, including account reconciliations, financial analysis and preparation of reporting packages in accordance with Corporate Accounting Policies and Procedures.
- Partner with finance, operations and other functional teams to understand business performance, identify trends and provide meaningful financial insights.
- Develop and maintain accurate, efficient financial models, reports and analytical tools using Excel and other business intelligence tools.
- Identify opportunities to improve reporting, processes and analytics as the FP&A organization continues to develop and mature.
- Take ownership of assigned areas by understanding the purpose and business drivers behind the work, identifying issues and proactively pursuing solutions.
- Champion the Oshkosh “People First” competencies to engage, develop and connect team members.
- Identify and support continuous improvement projects while leveraging the Oshkosh Continuous Improvement Management System (CIMS) tools and concepts.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance or Accounting.
- Two (2) or more years of professional experience in finance, accounting, financial analysis or a related area OR Finance/Accounting internship experience within Oshkosh Corporation.
- Strong proficiency with Microsoft Excel and the ability to work with, organize and analyze detailed financial data.
- Strong attention to detail with demonstrated ability to produce accurate work and manage multiple priorities.
- Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

STANDOUT QUALIFICATIONS
- Previous Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) experience, including forecasting, budgeting and management reporting.
- Experience supporting pricing, bid margin analysis, profitability analysis or other commercial finance activities.
- Public accounting experience.
- Experience with Power BI, including developing or working with financial dashboards and reporting.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables and analysis of large data sets.
- Experience with capital expenditure reporting, backlog analysis, shipment tracking or other operational finance metrics.
- Experience working within a manufacturing or similarly operational business environment.
- Experience with Sightline, Infor LN or another ERP/financial reporting system.
- Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting or a related discipline.

jobs.description:
About Pratt Miller, an Oshkosh company

Pratt Miller is a product development company in motorsports, defense, and mobility industries providing clients with product engineering and low-volume production solutions. Our range of research & development, engineering, prototype manufacturing, test & validation, and low-rate production capability help our customers bring their high-quality products to market faster.

Pratt Miller is seeking a Program Manager to lead complex, cross-functional engineering programs from planning through integration, validation, and delivery. The role is accountable for customer satisfaction and disciplined program execution, including scope, schedule, financial performance, risk mitigation, and delivery.

PROGRAMS MAY SPAN THE FOLLOWING AREAS
- Autonomous Systems Integration: Integrating autonomy, drive-by-wire, sensing, compute, and controls into real-world platforms.
- Deployable Infrastructure: Designing and integrating rapidly deployable systems for power, compute, communications, and energy management.
- Advanced Vehicle Technology Integration: Integrating new technologies including electrification, power systems, suspension, controls, and specialized equipment onto mobile platforms.

TOP REQUIRED FUNCTIONS AND SKILLS
- Lead complex engineering programs and concurrent technical workstreams, establishing clear scope, milestones, schedules, budgets, resource plans, risks, deliverables, and customer commitments.
- Partner with technical leads and functional managers to coordinate systems, mechanical, electrical, software, controls, procurement, prototype build, integration, test, validation, and deployment activities.
- Lead customer and internal program reviews, clearly communicating technical progress, financial performance, key decisions, risks, dependencies, and issues requiring action or leadership support.
- Drive cross-functional execution and timely resolution of technical, integration, supply-chain, schedule, and resource issues while maintaining appropriate technical ownership within engineering.
- Manage scope and requirement changes, assess cost and schedule impacts, maintain contractual alignment, and ensure requirements, acceptance criteria, and deliverables are tracked through completion.
- Support new and follow-on business by helping define execution approaches, schedules, resource needs, risks, and cost estimates, and by transitioning awarded work into disciplined program execution.
- Build effective relationships across engineering, operations, manufacturing, business development, customers, suppliers, and partners; demonstrate sound judgment and adaptability as requirements and priorities evolve.

EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline.
- 7–10 years of experience in program management, project management, engineering, or product development involving complex systems integration, autonomous systems, advanced vehicle technologies, deployable infrastructure, or related electromechanical systems.
- Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional technical programs, including responsibility for schedules, budgets, resources, risks, customer relationships, integration, testing, and delivery.

DESIRED SPECIALIZED SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE
- Experience with one or more relevant technology domains, including autonomous systems, drive-by-wire, electrification, power and energy systems, or advanced vehicle technologies.
- Working knowledge of systems engineering, requirements management, system architecture, interface management, verification and validation, and hardware/software integration.
- Strong technical communication skills and the ability to work effectively with customers and engineering teams to translate objectives and requirements into executable program plans.
